bcu search-ui [options]

Search the saved outline of one state, including elements the view folded away.

Options:
  --state <value>           stateId from observe-ui (required)
  --text <value>            substring of any name, value or OCR text
  --role <value>            role word, e.g. button, textfield, row
  --action <value>          capability, e.g. press, setText, scroll
  --limit <n>               maximum matches to return (default 12, max 50)
  --json                    emit one JSON object on stdout

bcu find-roots [options]

List controllable roots: windows, sheets, dialogs and open menus.

Options:
  --query <value>           match app name or window title
  --app <value>             restrict to one app name or bundle id; an exact name excludes longer names containing it
  --bundle-id <value>       restrict to one exact bundle id
  --pid <n>                 restrict to one process id
  --kind window|menubar|menu|sheet|popover|dialog restrict to one root kind; menubar roots are listed only when this or an app names them
  --json                    emit one JSON object on stdout

bcu observe-ui [options]

Observe one root and return a stateId with the projected element tree.

Options:
  --app <value>             app name or bundle id
  --window-title <value>    exact or partial window title
  --root <value>            @r ref from find-roots, or a numeric window id
  --mode semantic|fused     semantic: accessibility only (default); fused: also capture an image and OCR
  --image never|always      write a screenshot artifact (default never)
  --read-text auto|always|never OCR policy; auto (default) reads the screen only when the root exposes almost no accessibility content
  --json                    emit one JSON object on stdout

bcu search-ui [options]

Search the saved outline of one state, including elements the view folded away.

Options:
  --state <value>           stateId from observe-ui (required)
  --text <value>            substring of any name, value or OCR text
  --role <value>            role word, e.g. button, textfield, row
  --action <value>          capability, e.g. press, setText, scroll
  --limit <n>               maximum matches to return (default 12, max 50)
  --json                    emit one JSON object on stdout

bcu expand-ui [options]

Expand one element of a saved state, walking the live UI when the subtree was cut short.

Options:
  --state <value>           stateId from observe-ui (required)
  --ref <value>             element ref from the same state, e.g. @e12 (required)
  --depth <n>               levels to unfold below the element (default 3, max 8)
  --json                    emit one JSON object on stdout

bcu inspect-ui [options]

Print every raw accessibility field of one element, including the ones the projection hides.

Options:
  --state <value>           stateId from observe-ui (required)
  --ref <value>             element ref from the same state, e.g. @e12 (required)
  --json                    emit one JSON object on stdout

bcu act-ui - [options]

Run a checked action array from stdin against one state and return the successor state.

Options:
  --state <value>           stateId from observe-ui (required)
  --headless                never activate, focus or move the pointer physically
  --foreground              start in the foreground: activate the app and use real input
  --image never|always      write a screenshot artifact (default never)
  --expect-text <value>     postcondition: this text must appear
  --expect-role <value>     postcondition: an element with this role must appear
  --expect-value <value>    postcondition: an element must hold this exact value
  --expect-gone             invert the postcondition: it must disappear
  --scope <value>           limit the condition to this element subtree, e.g. @e12
  --timeout <n>             condition timeout in ms (default 10000, max 60000)
  --json                    emit one JSON object on stdout

bcu read-text [options]

Read the full text of one element, a slice at a time.

Options:
  --state <value>           stateId from observe-ui (required)
  --ref <value>             element ref from the same state, e.g. @e12 (required)
  --offset <n>              first character to read (default 0)
  --limit <n>               characters to read (default 4000, max 100000)
  --json                    emit one JSON object on stdout

bcu wait-for [options]

Wait for text or a role to appear or disappear, then return the successor state.

Options:
  --state <value>           stateId from observe-ui (required)
  --text <value>            text that must appear
  --role <value>            role word that must appear
  --scope <value>           limit the condition to this element subtree, e.g. @e12
  --gone                    wait for the condition to disappear instead
  --timeout <n>             condition timeout in ms (default 10000, max 60000)
  --json                    emit one JSON object on stdout

bcu status

Report resident process status without starting it.

Options:
  --json                    emit one JSON object on stdout

bcu doctor

Start and diagnose the resident process, permissions and config.

Options:
  --json                    emit one JSON object on stdout

bcu setup

Register and verify macOS permissions.

Options:
  --json                    emit one JSON object on stdout

bcu stop

Stop the resident process if it is running.

Options:
  --json                    emit one JSON object on stdout
